description_html:
The Uwell Caliburn G4 Pod Kit features a full-colour display, 1300mAh battery, and PRO-FOCS 4.0 technology. Works with the GPP pod platform for rich, consistent flavour with adjustable airflow.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 1300mAh
  • Wattage: Up to 35W
  • Charging: USB Type-C
  • Display: 0.85" Colour Screen (3 Menu Themes)
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 3mL
  • Coil Resistance: Integrated Mesh
  • Airflow: Adjustable
  • Pod Compatibility: Caliburn GPP Pods (0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.9Ω, 1.2Ω), Caliburn G3 Pods
  • Brand: Uwell

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.

Available options: Polar Black, Twilight Silver.
